serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I will call him first…
You: What’s up Big Daddy, can I come by? 
Big Daddy: Oh man, I’m very sorry little one, but there’s an emergency at my gallery. Some kid vomited on a 600k $ self-portrait of Seth Rogen in a thong. Let’s try catching up later!
You: I can wait a little.
Big Daddy: I don’t know what to tell you, I need to help fill up bankruptcy papers for that kid's parents and all that crying and whining of theirs is not helping.
Big Daddy: As I told you, being an owner of an art gallery ain’t easy! It’s similar to pimping in that regard, but commodities are more expensive and more fragile. 
You: Uh…{{wi}} If you say so…
Big Daddy: Listen buddy, let me make it up to you. How about dinner sometime? 
You: Sounds great!
